runtimeEvidence.summary: Official WeChat automation observed the actual detail-page state transition resolving -> requesting -> pending -> verified against the live canonical async endpoint.

After changing the selected head item, the old verified stat signature remained visible only with stale=true and readOnly=true during resolve/request/pending, then a distinct verified signature replaced it for the current item.

All 40 public specs remained verified with one raiderio_observed_profile template, zero baseline templates and canApplyGear=true; Catalyst remained capabilityEnabled=false, frontendMaySynthesize=false and failClosed=true.
No refresh or sync backflow ran, backend and worker remained restart-free, and the final 15-minute error-priority journal query returned no entries.

The exact correction candidate preserved observed_profile_mage_arcane from initial load through stat invalidation and verified cache-hit rendering without a manual reload; project.config temporary urlCheck override was removed afterward.

risks.detail: Pure state caps requests at 15 and total time at 45 seconds, including bounded retry delay and per-request timeout; focused/full tests and the real candidate pending-to-verified flow passed.

Request serial plus canonical context identity reject old completions; real candidate evidence preserved the prior snapshot only as stale/read-only until the changed item received a distinct verified signature.
Both consumers use requestWebsimGearStatSnapshot and the same begin/apply/timeout state contract; active source has no requestWebsimGearStats call site.
The implementation diff is limited to four frontend modules and their tests; full verification proves backend, PG, worker, public and Catalyst characterization remains green.
